thread:
maria: Morning — quick triage snapshot for early shift.

maria: Queue: 18 open (4 P1s, 7 P2s, rest P3). Tickets trending up due to embed failures overnight.

maria: Known issue: embedding service 2 (eu-west) flaky after config rollout — customers seeing 504s. Ops team rolling back now. @jamal can you confirm rollback progress?

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback to embed-service v1.3.8 initiated by jamal at 08:07 UTC. Estimated 3m.

jamal: got it, rollback done on eu-west around 08:10. Monitoring 15m.

alex: On the P1 about billing double-charge — dug into logs, looks like webhook duplicate delivery from payments. I left a note in the ticket and added a tentative macro: `apology+refund-checklist`.

maria: Thanks @alex — can you open a PR for that macro? small copy tweak: "We’re sorry — we’ve issued a refund..."

alex: Will open in ~30m. Also pinging @taylor for review on the support-side instructions (steps to verify refunds).

taylor: Ack, I’ll review after standup. Quick note: two new tickets from the same customer about latency spike — appears to be regional cache miss. Adding macro `cache-warm-guidance` to suggested macros.

maria: Nice. Current handover asks: someone to own P1 billing until 12:00 UTC, and keep an eye on embed flakiness. @jamal doing monitoring, but need coverage if it resurfaces.

taylor: I can take billing P1 until 12:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks. Also, tiny housekeeping: updated macros list — ran a spellcheck pass, removed deprecated `embed-fallthrough` macro. If you rely on it, flag here.

jamal: Noted, no one on infra uses `embed-fallthrough` afaik.

alex: PR: https://git.redwood/inbox/macros/pulls/42 (draft) — contains apology+refund-checklist + cache-warm-guidance suggestions.

maria: Perfect. Reminders: if you escalate a P1, add the incident tag and ping #eng-oncall. Otherwise we risk missing paging logic.

taylor: FYI — I'll do a quick macro test with a staged ticket to confirm formatting.

ops-bot: [ticket-bot] New ticket #98321 created: "Embedding 504 in EU" — assigned to jamal.

maria: thanks. Any blockers? no blockers from me except the embed monitoring.

jamal: monitoring looks stable so far, but will reopen if errors > 5% in next 20m.

alex: No blockers on CR; just waiting on taylor review.

taylor: Reviewing now, ETA 25m.

maria: Awesome—I'll post a short update at 09:00 UTC with final counts and handoff.

maria: quick checklist for whoever grabs P1: 1) confirm refund issued, 2) confirm webhook suppression, 3) leave note + macro used.

End.
